rule: Every `unsafe` keyword outside comments and literals is one boundary. `unsafe fn <name>` is an unsafe function; its contract is a `/// # Safety` line in the doc comment attached to it, which is the unbroken run of doc comment, comment and attribute lines above its first line. `unsafe {` is an unsafe block; its contract is a `// SAFETY:` comment in the unbroken run of comment lines directly above the line holding the keyword or above the first line of the statement that holds it. `unsafe fn(` is a function pointer type and carries no contract of its own. Any other use fails the script.
